subject: general
question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c42c70205f4c0688e3497119051eadb8d741d8f5fa7e5a08f038e8591968f704.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: **The number in the circle is the sum of the squares of the other three numbers.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0573b89cf91a897b3b833952d39d380d5839e82dea2bf903bf3879db34568d1e.png] 

→ 29 = (2)² + (3)² + (4)²

→ 29 = 4 + 9 + 16

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/17f4d46abd891ae061b03814ca6e2a861b79b92188303b7f45ed030ff517e258.png] 

→ 69 = (1)2 + (8)2 + (2)2

→ 69 = 1 + 64 + 4

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f88f39ccc6e2a8e88b100cc82c47a68b1cbb4daa728d3b90f9926c853e2542f1.png] 

→ ? = (7)2 + (2)2 + (5)2

→ ? = 49 + 4 + 25 = 78

Hence, the correct answer is **"78"**.
